name: FSR 1735 (Hubble)
blurb: FSR 1735, a globular cluster in the inner Milky Way, seen by Hubble.
label: fsr1735-hubble
story: A dense ball of stars in the inner Milky Way, its light dimmed by a cloud of gas and dust along our line of sight, and found in a near-infrared search of the sky. Hubble peered through the dust to measure the cluster's age.

claims.text: FSR 1735 is a previously unknown globular cluster in the inner Galaxy
FSR 1735 was found in a 2MASS-based near-infrared cluster search
Its extinction is mostly caused by a single cloud of gas and dust in the line of sight
Hubble program 14074 measures ages of highly reddened globular clusters toward the Galactic bulge, including FSR 1735
FSR 1735 is treated as a globular cluster in later work
